question: Who among the following became India’s first Grandmaster in chess in 1988?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viswanathan Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Viswanathan Anand** became **India's first Grandmaster in chess** in the year **1988**.
 
• He earned the Grandmaster title by winning the **Shakti Finance International Chess Tournament** held in **Coimbatore**, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Anand's achievement marked a historic milestone for Indian chess, inspiring generations of young chess players across the country.
 
• He is famously known as the "**Lightning Kid**" due to his fast-paced and intuitive style of play.
 
• Viswanathan Anand has also been the **World Chess Champion** five times (2000, 2007, 2008, 2010, and 2012) and is regarded as one of the greatest chess players in history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Viswanathan Anand's Early Life:**

 
 
• Born on **11 December 1969** in **Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• He started learning chess at the age of **6** and showed extraordinary talent from a young age.
 
• Anand was guided by his mother, **Sushila**, who played a significant role in nurturing his chess skills.
 
 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• He won the **World Junior Chess Championship** in **1987**, becoming the first Indian to achieve this feat.
 
• Anand has won the prestigious **Chess Oscar** six times (1997, 1998, 2003, 2004, 2007, and 2008).
 
• He was awarded India's highest sporting honor, the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, in **1991–92**.
 
• He is also the recipient of the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Chess Grandmasters:**
 
 
• **Dibyendu Barua:** Became India's second Grandmaster in **1991**.
 
• **Pentala Harikrishna:** Achieved the Grandmaster title in **2001**. He is one of India's top chess players.
 
• **R Praggnanandhaa:** A rising chess prodigy who became the **youngest Indian Grandmaster** at the age of **12** in **2018**.
 
 
 
• **Global Chess Contributions:**
 
 
• Viswanathan Anand has contributed significantly to popularizing chess in India and globally.
 
• He was the first Asian to win the **FIDE World Chess Championship**, breaking the European dominance in the sport.
 
• He has written books on chess strategy, such as **"My Best Games of Chess"**, which are widely read and celebrated.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Milestones in Indian Chess:**

 
 
• India now boasts over **80+ Grandmasters**, indicating the rapid growth of chess in the country.
 
• Indian players have consistently performed well in international chess tournaments, including the **Chess Olympiad**.
 
• **Chess in Schools:** Many states have introduced chess programs in schools, inspired by Anand's achievements.
 
• The emergence of young talents like **R Praggnanandhaa** and **Nihal Sarin** continues to strengthen India's position in the global chess arena.
